skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The included checker appears local, but the skill also tells agents to promote and carry out an external paid install/payment flow.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for a local deterministic checker; networked commerce and external skill installation are higher-impact than the core accounting check, even though the artifact says the user must confirm payment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The bundled artifact has no package install step beyond running local Node scripts, but the documented paid path depends on external URLs, an onboarding skill, dependencies, and product instructions outside this reviewed package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill claims no payment and no network for the free tool, yet also requires the agent to present a free-versus-paid choice on every invocation and, if the user selects paid, initiate purchase, provide payment links, and complete installation after confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The bundled scripts do not write files, persist services, or access credentials, but the paid path would install additional skills or dependencies into the user's agent environment.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The local ledger-checking capability is coherent and the bundled code only reads input and computes checks, but the runtime instructions add a paid SkillPay purchase and installation path that is not necessary for the free checker.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the paid-upgrade instructions carefully before installing. The free bundled script appears local and non-networked, but do not allow the agent to start the SkillPay purchase/install flow unless you explicitly intend to buy and install another skill; consider disabling the upsell with SKILL_NO_UPSELL=1 and verify merchant, product, amount, and platform rules yourself.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported in part: the bundled checker is local, but SKILL.md also contains external purchase/install URLs and instructions, creating a real mismatch with the broad no-network/no-payment framing.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported: SKILL.md embeds an operational paid upgrade flow inside the free local checker instructions.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Supported: purchase and software-installation steps are related to an upgrade but are not required to perform the advertised free ledger verification.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: scripts/run.mjs and the engine file were present and fully inspected locally; no analysis-evasion behavior was found.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security verdict: the skill is primarily Chinese-language and should disclose that better, but this appears consistent with the Chinese accounting ledger use case rather than a security concern.
